user.title: WEG Solar Portal
user.description: Enter the API credentials generated in the WEG Solar Portal under 'API Management' (Gestão de API). Each plant is added as a separate entry.

data_description.api_key: The API Key generated in the WEG Solar Portal API Management section.
data_description.api_secret: The API Secret shown when the key was created (displayed only once).

plant.title: Select plant
plant.description: Choose the plant to add. The other plants linked to this key can be added later; they will also show up as discovered.

data_description.plant_id: Plant linked to this API key.

discovery_confirm.title: WEG Solar plant discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the plant **{name}** using the API key already configured?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate WEG Solar Portal
reauth_confirm.description: The API credentials for {name} are no longer valid. Enter new credentials.

data_description.api_key: The API Key generated in the WEG Solar Portal API Management section.
data_description.api_secret: The API Secret shown when the key was created.
